$comment: Custom MCP Server Configuration Template for lootbox.config.json

_documentation.description: Template for adding custom MCP servers to lootbox

fields.command: The executable to run (npx, uvx, node, python, etc.)
fields.args: Command-line arguments. Use -y with npx to auto-install.
fields.env: Environment variables. ${VAR} syntax pulls from shell environment.

setup_steps: 1. Replace 'your_server_name' with a descriptive name (will become mcp_your_server_name)
2. Update command and args for your MCP server package
3. Set required environment variables in your shell
4. Copy mcpServers block to your lootbox.config.json
6. Verify with: lootbox tools | grep mcp_your_server_name
troubleshooting: If server doesn't appear: Check that command runs manually
If auth fails: Verify env vars are exported before starting lootbox
If connection times out: Server may need longer to initialize
